title: SPREP Pacific Climate Change Portal
description: SPREP-hosted portal of Pacific climate change projects, data and country resources.
notes: Regional climate knowledge hub. Hosts third-party material with mixed rights; no single portal-wide licence confirmed. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: Pacific Climate Change Science and Adaptation Planning (PCCSP) Climate Projections
description: Country-level climate projections and observed trends for Pacific partner countries.
notes: Authoritative projection set for Pacific adaptation planning. Australian Government copyright; reuse terms not confirmed. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: Pacific Data Hub .Stat — Pacific Sea Level
description: SPC PDH.stat sea level dataflow (DF_SEA_LEVEL), annual series, served as SDMX-CSV.
notes: Pacific sea level record; complements the existing /pacific sea level endpoint. Replaces the BoM SEAFRAME project landing page with the PDH.stat sea level dataflow; licence varies by dataflow and is not confirmed for this one. Stage 02b: direct data-file URL, not live-verified (build sandbox has no outbound network to this host) — confirm with a live fetch before relying on it.

title: WMO OSCAR/Surface — Pacific Observing Station Metadata
description: WMO station registry metadata for Pacific Island synoptic and climate stations.
notes: Station metadata layer for WMO Pacific station data. WMO data policy (Resolution 1) governs exchange, not commercial resale. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.

title: NOAA Oceanic Niño Index (ONI)
description: Three-month running mean SST anomalies in the Niño 3.4 region, the operational ENSO index.
notes: US federal government work (public domain). Control case for a CLEAR licence path; already wrapped by the /pacific ENSO endpoint. URL is a portal landing page — needs direct data-file URL before live run can succeed.
